headlines.title: 당정 " 메가특구법 연내 처리 …미래대응기금 신설"
headlines.summary: (사진=연합뉴스) 더불어민주당과 정부가 3대 메가프로젝트 지원을 위한 메가특구특별법을 올해 안에 처리하기로 했다. 한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 13일 국회에서 2026 경제성장전략 당정협의에서 "메가특구특별법과 전략수출금융지원법 등 주요 입법을 연말까지 처리하겠다"고 강조했다.

headlines.title: 당정 " 메가특구 특별법 신속 제정…주택공급은 확대"
headlines.summary: [더불어민주당 한정애 정책위의장이 13일 국회 의원회관에서 열린 2026 하반기 경제성장전략 당정 협의에서 인사말을 하고 있다. (사진=연합뉴스)] 더불어민주당과 정부는 올 하반기 3대 메가프로젝트(반도체·데이터센터·피지컬AI)를 속도감 있게 추진하는 데 역량을 모으기로 했습니다.

headlines.title: 내일 부동산 토론회 도 ‘ 규제 ’에 초점… ‘공급 확대’ 없인 피해 떠안...
headlines.summary: 세제 개편·대출 규제 등 예고 “집값 더 올릴 것” 전망도 나와 정부가 부동산 가격 안정을 위해 14일부터 릴레이 정책 공개토론회를 예고하고 나섰지만 논의 방향이 부동산 세 부담 강화, 대출 억제 등 규제 강화로 향해 있어 향후 2030세대의 내 집 마련은 더 요원해질 수 있다는 지적이 나오고 있다.

headlines.title: “ 규제로 집값 잡힐까 ”… 릴레이 토론·업무보고 ‘ 정책 슈퍼위크 ’ [부...
headlines.summary: 세제 개편안 발표 전 여론수렴 14~16일 부처별 사전 토론회 진행 23일 李대통령 대국민토론회 주재 공급·금융·세제 청사진 제시될 듯 정부가 보유세, 거래세 개편을 비롯한 부동산 정책 대수술을 예고한 가운데 이번주부터 각 부처별 부동산 토론회에 돌입한다.  [헤럴드 DB] 부동산 정책 방향을 가를 ‘부동산 슈퍼위크’가 14일부터 열흘간 펼쳐진다.

headlines.title: 경기도에 ‘ 첫 집 ’ 2030 1년새 1만명 증가
headlines.summary: 서울 집값급등에 부담 덜한 수도권행 경기 생초 매수 60.2%, 1년만 24% 늘어 성남시 수정구 216→1187명, 450% ↑ 동탄 첫집 마련 3328명 경기도 최다 올해 경기도에서 ‘내 집 마련’에 나선 매수자 열 중 여섯은 2030 청년들로 나타났다.

headlines.title: ‘나이 30에도 부모에 얹혀산다’… 집값에 갇힌 2030 청년들

headlines.title: 무주택 신혼부부 내집마련 , 5년 전보다 5.4년 더 걸렸다
headlines.summary: 무주택 부부, 주택 구매까지 13.1년 서울 거주비율 줄고 경기 늘어 동탄·기흥·구리에 대한 토지거래허가구역 지정이 발효된 5일 경기도 화성시 동탄구 일대 아파트 단지 모습. 연합뉴스 무주택 신혼부부가 주택 구매에 이르기까지 13년 넘게 걸린 것으로 조사됐다.

headlines.title: 7월 1~10일 수출 298억달러 ‘ 최대 ’ … 반도체 호황에도 장비업계는 ‘...

headlines.title: 휘발유 공급가 인하 16일째 … 따라내린 주유소 18%뿐

headlines.title: 정부, 중동 정세 긴장 고조에 원유 수급 긴급점검
headlines.summary: 원유 수급상황 긴급 점검회의 산업통상부 제공 사진 최근 이란의 호르무즈 재봉쇄 발표와 미군의 이란 공습 등으로 중동정세 긴장이 다시 고조되자 정부가 원유 수급상황을 긴급 점검했습니다. 산업통상부 문신학 차관은 오늘(13일) 오전 원유 수급상황 긴급 점검회의를 열고, 유조선 통항상황을 비롯한 원유 수급상황을 점검했습니다.

headlines.title: ‘ 콩나물 콩 ’ TRQ 1만t 증량
headlines.summary: 정부가 최근 공급 부족으로 상승 조짐을 보이는 콩나물용 콩 가격을 잡기 위해 다음 달부터 저율관세 수입 물량을 1만t 증량한다. 정부는 콩나물 재배용 콩에 대한 시장접근물량(TRQ)을 1만t 확대한다고 13일 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 폭염·호우 땐 공공계약 공사 중단 … 재경부 업무 처리 지침 안내

key_headlines.title: July 1-10 Exports Hit Record 29.8 Billion Dollars Amid Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's first-week July exports are tracking to exceed 100 billion dollars monthly, driven by sustained semiconductor demand, though domestic equipment manufacturers face challenges from increased overseas equipment imports.

key_headlines.title: Young Adults in Their 30s Trapped by Housing Costs, Unable to Leave Parents' Homes
key_headlines.summary: Rising apartment prices and scarce rental supply have pushed nearly 1 million households of adults aged 30 and elderly parents aged 60+ to cohabitate, deepening generational asset inequality and raising concerns about Japan-style social problems.

key_headlines.title: Government Launches Real Estate Policy 'Super Week' with Regulatory Focus
key_headlines.summary: Starting July 14, the government will conduct a series of relay policy discussions on comprehensive real estate reforms including property tax and transaction tax revisions, culminating in a presidential townhall on July 23.

key_headlines.title: 24-Hour Foreign Exchange Trading Shows Stable Performance in First Week
key_headlines.summary: Daily currency volatility decreased from 11.6% to 8.5% following the launch of round-the-clock forex trading, though early morning trading vulnerabilities remain a challenge.

key_headlines.title: 2027 National Tax Revenue Expected to Exceed 500 Trillion Won, Historic High
key_headlines.summary: The Minister of Strategy and Finance announced that 2027 national tax revenue is projected to significantly surpass the initial forecast of 412 trillion won, reaching 500 trillion won plus alpha.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's semiconductor sector continues to drive exceptional economic performance, with July's first-week exports tracking toward a record 100 billion dollar monthly figure. However, this boom masks underlying challenges, as domestic equipment manufacturers struggle with rising overseas equipment imports that offset semiconductor gains. Meanwhile, a critical social economic issue has emerged with nearly 1 million households of adults aged 30 living with elderly parents aged 60-plus due to soaring housing costs, deepening generational wealth inequality. The government has responded by announcing a comprehensive 'real estate super week' featuring policy discussions and eventual regulatory reforms to address affordability.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's fiscal outlook has brightened significantly, with the Minister of Strategy and Finance projecting 2027 national tax revenue to exceed 500 trillion won plus additional amounts, far surpassing the original 412 trillion won forecast. This represents the highest tax revenue in history. Meanwhile, the Federal Reserve continues to signal potential rate hike flexibility, with economists revising inflation forecasts upward to 2% from April's 2.9% projection. The U.S. economy appears resilient against geopolitical risks, with recession probabilities declining despite Iran-related tensions, though inflationary pressures persist.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean stock market experienced volatility with the KOSPI triggering circuit breakers and closing down 0.85%, while international tensions and energy price increases created headwinds for equity investments. The KOSDAQ showed relative strength, rising 3% despite broader market uncertainty. Currency markets demonstrated stabilization following the implementation of 24-hour forex trading, with daily volatility declining from 11.6% to 8.5%. The Korean won's opening-closing gap narrowed from 3.5 won to 1.9 won, indicating improved market stability, though early morning trading remains vulnerable to shocks.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's semiconductor industry continues its momentum with major companies and startups asserting that AI demand remains unlimited, with energy supply as the only true constraint, effectively countering 'semiconductor peak' theory. The industry celebrated award-winning advances in battery technology and semiconductor manufacturing processes, with LG Chemistry and Samsung engineers recognized for innovative carbon nanotube and critical mineral processing developments. Additionally, research into fungal-based lithium extraction from discarded batteries offers promising solutions to Korea's heavy reliance on mineral imports. Samsung's union has raised concerns about regional semiconductor expansion plans, with 84% opposing Honam province development.
sections.Real Estate: The real estate market shows increasing concentration among major construction company branded apartments, with 2025 data revealing strong demand clustering around established developers as market uncertainty persists. Long-term lease (20-year) contracts in public housing are generating significant disputes as tenants face mounting renewal demands and renewal costs, raising fairness concerns about government housing programs. Government regulatory discussions focusing on property taxation and loan restrictions have generated criticism that supply-side solutions are inadequate, potentially further delaying home ownership for younger generations. Brand reputation and developer credibility have become critical factors in apartment subscription markets, increasingly outweighing location considerations.
sections.International Economy: Escalating U.S.-Iran tensions have created significant geopolitical and economic risks, with Iran threatening to blockade the Strait of Hormuz while the U.S. conducts comprehensive military operations, creating uncertainty for global oil markets and supply chains. The U.S. Federal Reserve is undertaking significant structural reforms, with Chair Kevin Wash establishing task forces to reassess monetary policy communication, balance sheet strategy, and inflation frameworks by year-end. Experts warn that the U.S. faces persistent inflation despite economic resilience, suggesting limited room for interest rate cuts and complicating global monetary policy coordination. Trump administration policies show signs of embracing 'crony capitalism' approaches, with corporate tax burdens declining as a percentage of GDP despite rising profit shares.
sections.AI & Economy: South Korea's data center market has emerged as a critical alternative investment asset, driven by expanding AI demand, limited supply, and significant global capital inflows, positioning it as a core holdings category for sophisticated investors. A physical AI industrial safety company won the Ministry of Employment and Labor's top prize, demonstrating Korea's technological capabilities in AI-powered workplace safety solutions. Multiple AI development companies including OpenAI, Meta, and SpaceX are intensifying competition to develop low-cost, high-efficiency AI systems, reshaping the competitive landscape. Korea is positioning itself as an Asia-Pacific AI center through strategic initiatives like APEC engagement, recognizing that AI leadership will determine future national competitiveness across economic, industrial, diplomatic, and security dimensions.
sections.Others: SK Hynix's 26.5 billion dollar NASDAQ fundraising is expected to provide substantial foreign exchange market relief as the company converts dollars to won for domestic investments, easing external currency pressures. Mutual aid associations face funding constraints in alternative investment markets despite favorable conditions, as banking sector deposit flows show reversal phenomena with cash concentrating in regular deposits. Indonesia and Vietnam present new opportunities for Korean developers, with Daewoo E&C expanding AI data center and real estate development cooperation agreements based on successful StarLake City development experience. The government expanded soybean sprout production through increased tariff-rate quota allocations by 10,000 tons, addressing domestic agricultural supply concerns.
